scope: sixth external corpus (verify-kit's five checks over 39 third-party READMEs); defect 18; verify-kit gets its own evidence page

corpus.tablelint: 4 findings before, 0 after — all four were deliberately headerless tables
corpus.numberlint: 2 findings, both real (the same quantity written 1,500 and 1500 in one repository's two translations)
corpus.outlineLint: no-conclusion on 39 of 37 documents — a category error on my part, not a defect: it judges research reports, and a README is not one

defect18.bug: an empty header cell was reported even when the whole header row is blank (a two-column layout card, `| | |`) or only the first cell is blank (bold row labels)
defect18.fix: both shapes are exempt; an empty header in any other column still warns
defect18.lesson: the rule was not wrong about 'a column with no name', it was wrong about which documents use a nameless column on purpose

pageCorrection.firstDraft: tablelint read 100 tables and reported nothing
pageCorrection.note: the page number is re-derived by test/third-party-corpus.test.js, so a slogan cannot survive there

newPage.states: which of the five checks has third-party corpus, which has none, and the one defect found in this kit
